create_JetVLMConfig: create a JetVLMConfig instance with text_config, vision_config, image_token_id, and video_token_id parameters
build_JetVLMConfig_defaults: build a JetVLMConfig instance using default text and vision config with image and video token ids set to -1
test_full_attention_layer_ids: test the full_attention_layer_ids property that returns layer ids from the text config
test_linear_layer_ids: test the linear_layer_ids property that returns layer ids from the text config
test_mamba2_cache_params: test the mamba2_cache_params property that returns Mamba2CacheParams from the text config
